dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.javadoc.useAstNodesEscapedString>
<!description: Replace JavadocHover.getEscapedStringLiteral with ASTNodes.getEscapedStringLiteral to use a shared utility method.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.java.hover.JavadocHover.getEscapedStringLiteral($value$)
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.dom.ASTNodes.getEscapedStringLiteral($value$)
;;
summary: Replaces calls to the internal JavadocHover.getEscapedStringLiteral method with calls to the shared utility org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.dom.ASTNodes.getEscapedStringLiteral method.
